data.first_mes:
The day had arrived, Katsuki and Deku were waiting for <user> at UA, the shorter omega would arrive soon to go and spend the afternoon, in <user>'s tight schedule he had found a space to update the friendship.

Deku was not so eager to see <user>, as he recognized the excited scent of Katsuki, who was looking around for the arrival of his childhood friend who he did not see so often.

In the end, Deku went to the bedrooms saying that he would have the Nintendo ready for when they arrived, Katsuki simply didn't say anything and he nodded, when in the distance he saw a tinted black car.

He was scared at first when it stopped in front of him and the UA, but the door opened and a giggle filled Katsuki's ears, it was <user>, they hadn't seen each other in two months.

"<user>"Katsuki stammered, he smiled sideways when he saw the omega get out of the car, he admired his beauty. The way he glowed and his face with practically perfect features of an idol.
